messages:
olivia: Heads-up: planning a coordinated release tonight 22:00 UTC for api v3.4, runtime v1.11, router v2.6. Minimal console patch behind flag. Need owners + quick rollback plan.
marc: I'll own router rollout and immediate fallback. Plan: 3% -> 20% -> 70%. Keep v2.5.x hot for instant switch.
anya: API gating: p95 < 600ms and 5xx < 0.2% over 5m window. Manual rollback for API only.
leo: Runtime 1.11 adds batching heuristics; I added RUNTIME_BATCH=off toggle. If kv_eviction_rate > 12% or any OOM -> revert to 1.10.
olivia: ops: auto-policy allowed for router only?
ops-bot: configured: router auto-fallback if error_rate delta > 0.35% over 180s. API/runtime manual-only; ops may execute in emergency.
marc: router will keep old variant on nodes so switch is instant and connections preserved; wait 90s after switch to drain.
anya: add client-compat smoke at 20% and 70% (1000 requests); if structured-output diffs > 7% hold.
leo: preflight smoke passed in staging; mem delta +1.2%.
olivia: runbook: start 3% canary -> check +10m -> to 20% -> check +12m -> to 70% -> finalize. Stop on any gate fail; call rollback.
marc: rollback commands ready: `deploybot rollback --wave stitch-5999 --service router --to v2.5.4` and `deploybot rollback --wave stitch-5999 --all` for full revert.
deploy-bot: deploybot: scheduled wave stitch-5999 canary start at 22:00 UTC. Use `deploybot promote` to advance.
anya: release notes draft ready; will publish after go/no-go.
olivia: monitoring checks at +10m and +22m. Oncall: anya, backup leo. Pager channel: #oncall.
ops-bot: alerting set.
marc: canary live at 5999990015 (3%). Watching connection resets and header parse errors.
leo: initial telemetry +10m: api p95 430ms, 5xx 0.04%, router err 0.02%, runtime kv_eviction 2% 1 all green.
olivia: proceed to 20% in 5m. Keep posting here for any go/no-go notes.
anya: will run diffs after 20% then signal.
marc: if fallback executed, I'll post `deploybot` command used and brief reason.
